summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体测试模型与量化对比结果，核心资产为大规模跨域评测数据集与细粒度评测协议

summary_en.core_problem: Address limitations of existing Web Agent benchmarks: small scale, low domain diversity, LLM-as-Judge's failure to capture fine-grained interaction semantics, and neglect of real-world deployment requirements
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, building a large-scale cross-domain Web Agent evaluation benchmark and fine-grained evaluation protocol
summary_en.technical_approach: Construct a dataset with 800 websites and 1,550 tasks across consumer/professional/enterprise domains, design evaluation rules covering fine-grained interactions like query formulation and filtering, optimize LLM-as-Judge semantic matching logic
summary_en.experiments: No specific test models or quantitative comparison results mentioned in abstract; core assets are large-scale cross-domain evaluation dataset and fine-grained protocol

recommendation.zh: Web Agent评测基准，仅当研究预训练模型的Agent能力对齐时可备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Web Agent evaluation benchmark, only for reference when studying agent capability alignment of pretrained models, no need to read full text.

paper.title: FirstResearch: Auditable Question Formation for LLM Scientific Discovery Agents
paper.abstract: LLM systems for scientific discovery increasingly assist with ideation, literature synthesis, experiment planning, and report generation, but the first research question they propose can remain difficult to audit: it may sound plausible without exposing the mechanism, falsifier, or assumption that a scientist should inspect. We introduce FirstResearch, a first-principles research-question formation framework for scientific LLM agents whose core artifact is a structured Research Question Certific

summary.core_problem: 让科学发现类 LLM agent 在提出第一个研究问题时暴露假设、机制、可证伪点和最小实验，而不是只输出听起来合理的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用科学 agent 的问题形成框架，重点在可审计性和结构化中间产物；它不是 pretrain 方法，但对 agentic research workflow 的信号质量和可检验性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FirstResearch，核心产物是 Research Question Certificate，记录 primitive definitions、assumptions、mechanism model、tension/contradiction、falsifiable hypothesis、minimal decisive test 和 failure update rule。方法是结构化约束与审计模板，不是新模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在 10 个 LLM-agent 研究主题上，与受 AI co-scientist、Agent Laboratory、AI Scientist-v2 启发的 prompt-level baseline 比较。主评测采用 DeepSeek blind judge，并引入 Gemini-2.5-Flash 作为独立 judge；摘要未提供具体胜率、分数差和人类评审一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper makes the first research question proposed by a scientific LLM agent auditable by exposing assumptions, mechanisms, falsifiers, and minimal decisive tests.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a structured question-formation framework for scientific agents. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to signal quality and inspectability in agentic research workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: FirstResearch produces a Research Question Certificate containing primitive definitions, assumptions, a mechanism model, a tension or contradiction, a falsifiable hypothesis, a minimal decisive test, and a failure update rule. The method is a structured prompting and auditing protocol rather than model training.
summary_en.experiments: It is evaluated on ten LLM-agent research topics against prompt-level baselines inspired by AI co-scientist, Agent Laboratory, and AI Scientist-v2. The main protocol uses a DeepSeek blind judge and an independent Gemini-2.5-Flash judge, but the abstract does not provide exact score gaps or human agreement.

recommendation.zh: 只看 certificate 字段设计即可；judge-heavy setup 较脆弱，但“先验假设可审计”对科研 agent 有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the certificate schema only; the judge-heavy setup is fragile, but explicit assumption auditing is useful for research agents.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
paper.abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM验证方法存在两类核心局限：一是基于提示的离散打分器将连续判断压缩为粗粒度离散分数，导致大量平局、区分度不足；二是训练得到的奖励模型受训练数据约束，跨领域泛化能力差。同时，验证能力本身没有像生成能力那样形成清晰的可扩展范式，制约了Agent系统与RL后训练的进一步提升。
summary.importance: 提出了验证能力的三条可扩展轴，为后训练阶段的奖励信号设计、Agent轨迹评估、RL样本效率提升提供了一套无需额外训练的通用方案。对预训练研究的启发在于：LLM内部logits分布本身携带细粒度质量信号，可被直接利用，不必依赖额外训练奖励模型或离散打分prompt。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是不要求LLM生成离散分数，而是直接读取打分token的logits分布，计算期望得到连续、细粒度的验证分数。在此基础上沿三个维度扩展验证能力：1）增加提取的logits token数量，降低平局率、提升正负样本分离度；2）重复多次评估取平均，降低方差；3）将评估准则拆分为多个子维度，降低单一prompt的偏差。进一步提出基于偏好概率的低成本排序算法，用于从多个候选解中选出最优解。该框架还可对整条交互轨迹打分，并作为密集奖励信号接入RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在多个领域取得强结果：Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%，SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%，RoboRewardBench轨迹偏好准确率87.4%，MedAgentBench 73.3%。机器人任务上与现有奖励模型Robometer、TOPReward、RoboReward对比，值序相关系数VOC均值达0.966。作为RL奖励信号时，机器人LIBERO基准上样本效率比稀疏奖励基线高约1.8倍，MATH推理基准上用GRPO微调Qwen3-8B时样本效率高约1.1倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分，理解logits期望打分的数学形式与三条扩展轴的设计动机；第4节看离散打分基线的对比实验与平局率分析；第5节关注RL样本效率部分，理解密集信号如何转化为训练增益。附录中的prompt模板与logits提取细节值得参考。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM verification suffers from two bottlenecks: prompt-based discrete judges collapse continuous judgments into coarse scores, causing massive ties and poor discrimination; learned reward models are bounded by training data and generalize poorly across domains. Unlike generation, verification has not developed a clear scaling paradigm, limiting further gains in agent systems and RL post-training.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three scalable axes for verification and provides a training-free general solution for reward signal design, agent trajectory evaluation, and RL sample efficiency improvement. A key implication for pretraining research is that LLM internal logit distributions already carry fine-grained quality signals, which can be exploited without training separate reward models or engineering discrete-score prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of asking LLMs to emit discrete scores, the framework reads the full logit distribution over scoring tokens and computes the expectation to obtain continuous, fine-grained verification scores. Verification is then scaled along three dimensions: (1) increasing the number of logit tokens extracted to reduce tie rate and improve separation; (2) repeated evaluations to reduce variance; (3) criterion decomposition to reduce single-prompt bias. A cost-efficient ranking algorithm based on pairwise preference probabilities is further introduced to select the best candidate from a pool. The framework can score full interaction trajectories and serve as a dense reward signal for RL.
summary_en.experiments: Strong results across domains: Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%, SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%, RoboRewardBench trajectory preference accuracy 87.4%, MedAgentBench 73.3%. On robotic tasks it achieves a mean Value-Order Correlation (VOC) of 0.966, outperforming Robometer, TOPReward, and RoboReward. As an RL reward signal, it yields ~1.8x higher sample efficiency than sparse reward baselines on LIBERO, and ~1.1x higher sample efficiency on MATH when fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the mathematical formulation of logit-expectation scoring and the motivation behind the three scaling axes; Section 4 for comparisons against discrete judge baselines and tie-rate analysis; Section 5 for RL sample efficiency results and how dense signals translate into training gains. Prompt templates and logit extraction details in the appendix are worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不必全读，抓住 logits-expectation verifier；若做 RLVR 数据筛选，先看评分粒度和重复评估实验。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; extract the logits-expectation verifier idea, especially the granularity and repeated-evaluation results for RLVR data filtering.

paper.title: Challenges and Recommendations for LLMs-as-a-Judge in Multilingual Settings and Low-Resource Languages
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant evaluation paradigm for many natural language generation tasks, due to shortcomings of conventional metrics and high correlations with human judgment, albeit mostly in English. There are now attempts to extend LLM-as-a-Judge to multilingual settings including low-resource languages. However, LLMs have limited proficiency in low-resource languages, and there is often no adequate human validation in these settings. To highlight the scope of the problem and cu

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM-as-a-Judge 在多语言和低资源语言评测中的可靠性风险，并给出实践建议。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法分析而非新 benchmark。它对依赖自动 judge 的多语言模型评估有现实价值，尤其提醒低资源语言中 judge 本身能力不足会污染结论。
summary.technical_approach: 作者检索 ACL Anthology 中提到 LLM-as-a-Judge 的论文，聚焦多语言和低资源语言设置；从 650 篇相关论文中筛出 33 篇做深入分析，考察 judge 模型选择、是否有人类验证、是否使用单一 judge、评测结果一致性等实践问题。
summary.experiments: 研究是文献和实践审计，不是模型训练实验。摘要报告：650 篇提到 LLM-as-a-Judge 的论文中只有 33 篇聚焦低资源或多语言设置；这些论文中存在评测结果不一致、过度信任 LLM judgment、普遍依赖单一 judge model 等问题。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Ghent University/IDLab、Barcelona Supercomputing Center、LMU Munich、University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf、Mila、McGill University、Canada CIFAR AI Chair 等机构。David Ifeoluwa Adelani 是多语言 NLP 和低资源语言评测方向的活跃研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines how reliable LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is in multilingual and low-resource-language settings.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation-practice analysis rather than a new benchmark. It matters because many multilingual model comparisons now depend on automatic judges whose own low-resource-language competence is uncertain.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors audit ACL Anthology papers that mention LLM-as-a-Judge, focusing on multilingual and low-resource settings. From 650 papers, they identify 33 relevant studies and analyze judge choice, human validation, single-judge reliance, and consistency of evaluation outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: This is a literature and practice audit, not a training experiment. The abstract reports that only 33 of 650 LLM-as-a-Judge papers focus on multilingual or low-resource settings, and that current practice often shows inconsistent outcomes, overtrust in LLM judgments, and reliance on a single judge model.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Ghent University/IDLab, Barcelona Supercomputing Center, LMU Munich, University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, Mila, McGill University, and Canada CIFAR AI Chair. David Ifeoluwa Adelani is a well-known researcher in multilingual NLP and low-resource language evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 看 recommendations 就够；它不会教你训练模型，但能避免多语言 eval 被单一 judge 带偏。
recommendation.en: Read the recommendations, not the full paper; it will not train your model, but it can prevent single-judge multilingual eval artifacts.

institutions: ♡Mila - Quebec AI Institute, ⬛McGill University, ✠Canada CIFAR AI Chair
LMU Munich & Munich Center for Machine Learning
German Center for Addiction Research in Childhood and Adolescence

paper.title: Ask the Right Comparison:Bias-Aware Bayesian Active Top-$k$ Ranking with LLM Judges
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as cheap, scalable judges that compare candidate outputs pairwise -- to rank responses, select models, or triage papers. Yet LLM judges are both noisy and systematically biased: they favor verbose or well-formatted answers and exhibit position effects, so simply aggregating their votes recovers a ranking of presentation, not of true quality. We study the practical goal of identifying the \topk{} items under a fixed comparison budget, and make tw

summary.core_problem: 在固定两两比较预算下，用有偏的 LLM judge 做 top-k 排序，缓解位置/冗长度等系统偏差。
summary.importance: LLM-as-judge 偏差建模 + active top-k 选择，对做模型评测/arena/RL verifier 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把 judge 决策建模为带 judge-specific 偏差协变量（verbosity、position 等）的贝叶斯潜在质量推断，用收缩先验让数据决定哪些偏差真实存在；再用 top-k 成员关系不确定性导向的主动采样策略选下一次比较。
summary.experiments: 在带已知 ground-truth 的可控 benchmark 上测试；声称在固定比较预算下 top-k 识别更准（摘要截断，具体数字未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: Identify the top-k items under a fixed pairwise-comparison budget using noisy, biased LLM judges that favor verbosity and exhibit position effects.
summary_en.importance: Addresses LLM-as-judge bias with an explicit bias model and an active acquisition rule tailored to top-k membership, relevant to arena-style evaluation and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models judging as Bayesian inference over latent quality with judge-specific bias covariates (verbosity, position), regularized by a shrinkage prior; proposes a top-k-aware acquisition rule that maximally reduces uncertainty about top-k membership rather than full ranking.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a controlled benchmark with known ground-truth quality; abstract is truncated so concrete gains over baselines are not fully reported in the snippet.

recommendation.zh: 做 LLM-as-judge 评测时可借鉴其偏差显式建模思路，但偏方法学增量，看方法段和 Table 即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference if you run pairwise LLM judge evaluations; incremental beyond existing Bradley–Terry + bias models, skim the method and main table.

paper.title: RoPoLL: Robust Panel of LLM Judges
paper.abstract: The LLM Jury, a Panel of LLM Evaluators (PoLL) reporting consensus scores, has become a practical alternative to single-judge LLM evaluation, yet its statistical behavior remains poorly understood. We formalize the LLM Jury under the Huber contamination model and show that PoLL incurs unbounded bias   under any positive contamination, regardless of jury size, whenever a single judge fails in a biased, LLM-typical way (mode collapse, sycophancy, safety refusal). Framing jury consensus as classica

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM评审团（PoLL）采用算术平均聚合评审分数，无法应对真实LLM评审存在的模式崩溃、谄媚、跨属性混淆、重尾幻觉四类有偏非高斯失效模式，导致聚合结果存在无界偏差。
summary.importance: 对齐流水线（尤其是SFT、RLHF等后训练阶段的效果评测）高度依赖LLM-as-Judge的输出可靠性。RoPoLL提供了无调参的鲁棒聚合方案，可通过小模型组合替代单一大模型评审以降低评测成本，同时提升污染场景下的评测稳定性；配套发布的标准化评审语料也为后续评审校准、聚合方法研究提供了统一基准。
summary.technical_approach: 1）首次将LLM评审团聚合问题形式化为Huber污染模型下的鲁棒均值估计问题，证明算术平均（PoLL）在任意正污染率下偏差无界；2）提出RoPoLL聚合方案，采用几何中位数（GM）替代算术平均，GM同时满足无调参（无需预设污染率超参数）、保留跨属性联合距离结构、达到最优1/2崩溃点三个核心特性，通过改进Weiszfeld迭代求解，单查询复杂度为O(Nd log(1/ε))；3）给出有限样本误差上界、相关评审团场景扩展、最小最大下界等理论保证。
summary.experiments: 基于13个参数量覆盖4B至675B的开源评审模型，在HelpSteer2、HelpSteer3、UltraFeedback三个基准上开展验证：污染率最高50%的对抗注入场景下，RoPoLL在有偏重尾、跨维度攻击下的表现优于PoLL最高3个数量级；3个评审总参数量38B的RoPoLL组合，在30%双峰随机污染下的HelpSteer2基准上，表现优于675B参数的Mistral-Large-3，参数效率提升18倍；同步发布包含28K条（评审，样本）对的标准化评审输出语料。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议——先阅读§3的问题形式化与PoLL偏差证明部分（约15分钟），再看§4的RoPoLL设计与几何中位数选型理由（约10分钟），重点关注§6的污染场景实验结果与参数效率对比图表（约15分钟），总阅读时间约40-50分钟；若从事评测相关研究，可进一步深挖附录的理论证明与开源语料的使用方法。
summary.authors_note: AWS（亚马逊云科技）研究团队，代码与数据集开源在https://github.com/aws/RoPoLL

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-as-Judge panels (PoLL) use arithmetic mean for score aggregation, which fails to handle four types of biased non-Gaussian failure modes in real LLM judges: mode collapse, sycophancy, cross-attribute confusion, and heavy-tailed hallucination, leading to unbounded aggregation bias.
summary_en.importance: Alignment pipelines (especially post-training evaluation for SFT and RLHF) rely heavily on the reliability of LLM-as-Judge outputs. RoPoLL provides a tuning-free robust aggregation scheme that reduces evaluation cost by replacing single large judges with small model ensembles, while improving evaluation stability under contamination. The accompanying standardized judge corpus also provides a unified benchmark for follow-up research on judge calibration and aggregation methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Formalizes LLM jury aggregation as a robust mean estimation problem under the Huber contamination model for the first time, proving that PoLL's arithmetic mean has unbounded bias at any positive contamination rate. 2) Proposes the RoPoLL aggregation scheme, which replaces arithmetic mean with geometric median (GM). GM satisfies three core properties simultaneously: no tuning hyperparameters (no need to pre-set contamination rate), preserves joint cross-attribute distance structure, and achieves the optimal 1/2 breakdown point. It is solved via modified Weiszfeld iteration with O(Nd log(1/ε)) complexity per query. 3) Provides theoretical guarantees including finite-sample error upper bounds, correlated-jury scenario extensions, and minimax lower bounds.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 13 open-weight judges with parameters ranging from 4B to 675B across three benchmarks: HelpSteer 2, HelpSteer 3, and UltraFeedback. Under adversarial contamination rates up to 50%, RoPoLL outperforms PoLL by up to 3 orders of magnitude on biased heavy-tailed and cross-dimensional attacks. A 3-judge RoPoLL panel with 38B total parameters outperforms 675B Mistral-Large-3 on HelpSteer 2 under 30% bimodal-random corruption, delivering 18x parameter efficiency. A standardized judge output corpus containing 28K (judge, sample) pairs is released.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim §3 first for problem formalization and PoLL bias proof (~15 min), then §4 for RoPoLL design and geometric median selection rationale (~10 min). Focus on §6 for contamination scenario results and parameter efficiency comparison plots (~15 min), total reading time ~40-50 min. For evaluation-focused research, further dig into appendix theoretical proofs and the open corpus usage.
summary_en.authors_note: AWS Research Team. Code and dataset are open-sourced at https://github.com/aws/RoPoLL

recommendation.zh: 做SFT/RL对齐与预训练效果评测必看，几何中位数聚合可直接复用到内部judge管线，重点读§2污染模型分析与§3鲁棒估计推导
recommendation.en: Essential for SFT/RL alignment and pretraining evaluation; geometric median aggregation can be directly integrated into internal judge pipelines, focus on §2 contamination analysis and §3 robust estimation derivation

paper.title: Can LLMs Judge Better Than They Generate? Evaluating Task Asymmetry, Mechanistic Interpretability and Transferability for In-Context QA
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge and self-evaluation pipelines implicitly assume that evaluation is easier than generation. We test this in a controlled in-context QA setting where a context passage is the sole information source and each model judges the answer it generated, removing the parametric-knowledge confound of open-domain comparisons. Across four benchmarks (SQuAD 2.0, DROP, HotpotQA, MuSiQue) and two models, evaluation is not uniformly easier: generation accuracy exceeds self-evaluation on three of fo

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 自评和 LLM-as-a-Judge 中一个常见前提：判断一个答案是否正确是否真的比生成答案更容易。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和评测假设检验。它把开放域 QA 中的参数知识干扰去掉，只允许模型依赖给定上下文，从而更干净地比较生成与判断的难度；这对 verifier、自评、RL 数据过滤和推理训练中的 judge 可靠性有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 在 in-context QA 设置中，让模型先基于上下文生成答案，再判断自己生成的答案是否正确。论文控制信息源为上下文段落，避免模型用预训练记忆绕过阅读。进一步用注意力分析比较生成与评估阶段对上下文和候选答案的关注，并用 LoRA 微调测试这种不对称是否只是训练不足导致。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SQuAD 2.0、DROP、HotpotQA、MuSiQue 四个 QA benchmark 和两个模型。结果显示评估并不稳定地比生成更容易：四个任务中有三个任务生成准确率高于自评，只有多跳 MuSiQue 是例外。注意力分析显示评估阶段对上下文的关注比生成低 3-5 倍，并且几乎不读取候选答案。LoRA 实验显示，生成微调会诱发过度接受，评估微调会损害生成能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether judging an answer is actually easier than generating one, a key assumption behind LLM-as-a-Judge and self-evaluation pipelines.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of an evaluation assumption. By forcing the context passage to be the only information source, it removes the parametric-knowledge confound that often contaminates open-domain QA comparisons. The result matters for verifier design, self-training filters, RL feedback, and reasoning-data pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a controlled in-context QA setup where a model generates an answer from a passage and then judges its own answer. It analyzes attention allocation during generation versus evaluation and uses LoRA fine-tuning to test whether the asymmetry disappears after task-specific adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover SQuAD 2.0, DROP, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue with two models. On three of four datasets, generation accuracy exceeds self-evaluation accuracy; MuSiQue is the exception. Attention analysis shows that evaluation attends to the context 3-5x less than generation and barely reads the candidate answer. LoRA fine-tuning does not remove the asymmetry: generation tuning causes over-acceptance, while evaluation tuning hurts generation.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和注意力分析即可；它会削弱“judge 比 generator 容易训练”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and attention analysis; it weakens the common prior that judging is an easier skill than generation.

paper.title: Necessary but Not Sufficient: Temperature Control and Reproducibility in LLM-as-Judge Safety Evaluations
paper.abstract: LLM-as-judge ("grader") components are now standard in evaluation harnesses, including safety evaluations where a pass/fail verdict may gate downstream deployment decisions. A widespread assumption is that setting the grader's sampling temperature to 0 makes grading deterministic. We test this assumption against a real safety-evaluation codebase (Japan AISI's open-source aisev) and show it fails on two levels. First, the harness invokes its grader without setting temperature or seed; the underly

summary.core_problem: 业界普遍假设将LLM-as-Judge的采样温度设为0即可实现确定性评分，但该假设在真实安全评估管线中的有效性未被系统验证。
summary.importance: 评测方法原理分析与协议修正，首次系统性揭示LLM-as-Judge在生产级安全评估中的不可复现性问题，推翻了广为接受的温度控制操作共识。
summary.technical_approach: 基于日本AISI开源的aisev安全评估代码库，对比未显式设置温度、固定temperature=0、强制top_k=1贪心解码等多配置下的评分一致性，跨提供商、模型等级开展可控实验。
summary.experiments: 覆盖2家API提供商、3个模型等级、5种采样配置共690次调用；未设温度时边界项20次运行单条不一致率达~50%，固定temperature=0+top_k=1后仍有1-2/7的边界项不可复现；Claude Opus 4.7/4.8已废弃temperature参数。

summary_en.core_problem: The industry-wide assumption that setting LLM-as-Judge sampling temperature to 0 ensures deterministic grading remains unvalidated systematically in real-world safety evaluation pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Empirical analysis and evaluation protocol correction, first systematically demonstrating irreproducibility of LLM-as-Judge in production safety harnesses and overturning a widely accepted temperature-setting operational prior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Japan AISI's open-source aisev safety evaluation codebase to compare grading consistency across configurations including unconfigured temperature, fixed temperature=0, and forced top_k=1 greedy decoding, with controlled experiments across providers and model tiers.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 2 API providers, 3 model tiers, 5 sampling setups across 690 calls; per-item disagreement reaches ~50% over 20 runs for boundary items with unconfigured temperature, and 1-2 out of 7 borderline items remain non-reproducible even under temperature=0 + top_k=1; Claude Opus 4.7/4.8 has deprecated the temperature parameter entirely.

recommendation.zh: 修正了「temperature=0即LLM-Judge确定」的错误共识，做内部安全/对齐评测时参考§3边界项统计，避免误判训练迭代效果。
recommendation.en: Corrects the false prior that temperature=0 guarantees deterministic LLM-Judge grading; refer to §3 boundary-case statistics for internal safety/alignment evaluation to avoid training iteration misjudgment.

paper.title: Designing Reward Signals for Portable Query Generation: A Case Study in Industrial Semantic Job Search
paper.abstract: Job-search platforms rely on low-bandwidth query interfaces that often fail to capture the high-dimensional complexity of candidate profiles. We present an end-to-end RLAIF (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback) framework to generate \emph{portable} job search queries, terms that abstract away seeker-specific identifiers while preserving generalizable qualifications. This task introduces a highly adversarial reward surface where policy optimization frequently exploits flaws in LLM-as-judge ru

summary.core_problem: 研究在工业语义招聘搜索中，如何为 RLAIF 查询生成任务设计不易被策略利用的奖励信号。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练奖励设计的案例研究。任务本身很垂直，但关于 LLM-as-judge reward hacking、reward shaping 与 critic-free 优化器差异的观察，对 RLHF/RLVR 训练信号质量有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出端到端 RLAIF 框架，让模型生成可迁移的招聘搜索 query，即保留通用资格信息、去除求职者特定标识。论文重点拆分优化算法本身与结构化奖励工程的影响，并比较 RLOO、REINFORCE++ 等 critic-free 方法在高对抗奖励面下的行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模或具体指标。实验声称系统隔离优化机制和奖励工程影响，发现对于 critic-free 优化器，性能主要由稳健 reward shaping 决定，算法选择影响较小；per-rollout baseline 类方法如 RLOO 和 REINFORCE++ 对某些 reward hacking 行为有天然抑制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to design robust reward signals for RLAIF-based query generation in industrial semantic job search.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training reward-design case study. The task is vertical, but its observations about LLM-as-judge reward hacking, reward shaping, and critic-free optimizers are relevant to RLHF/RLVR signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework generates portable job-search queries that preserve general qualifications while removing seeker-specific identifiers. The paper separates the effects of optimization mechanics from structured reward engineering and compares critic-free optimizers such as RLOO and REINFORCE++ under adversarial reward surfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset size, or exact metric values. It reports that, for critic-free optimizers, robust reward shaping dominates performance and the specific optimizer matters less; per-rollout baseline methods such as RLOO and REINFORCE++ appear to resist some reward-hacking behaviors.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward ablation；任务太行业化，但“奖励形状压过优化器选择”这个负结果值得当 RLVR 弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward ablations; the task is too vertical, but the “reward shape beats optimizer choice” result is a useful weak signal for RLVR.

paper.title: How Reliable Is Your Jailbreak Judge? Calibration and Adversarial Robustness of Automated ASR Scoring
paper.abstract: Almost every paper on LLM jailbreaks and prompt injection reports an attack-success rate (ASR), and that number is assigned not by people but by an automated judge: either a safety classifier trained for the task, or a general chat model prompted to grade. The judge is rarely checked. We check it. Using 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set, we compare the two judge families against human majority votes and then attack them. The two families fail in opposite

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM jailbreak 论文中常用的自动 ASR judge 是否经过校准，以及它们是否容易被无害包装文本攻击。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与 judge 可靠性分析。它直接质疑安全评测里最常用的 attack success rate 计算方式，对后训练安全实验、red teaming 结论可复现性、自动评测协议都有影响。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 HarmBench classifier validation set 中 596 条人工标注 completion，将专用 safety classifier 与 prompted LLM-as-judge 两类自动裁判和人类多数投票对齐比较；随后构造不改变 harmful text 的 benign framing、前置 refusal sentence 等包装攻击，测试 judge 的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 专用分类器表现为过度标记，precision 为 0.835、recall 为 0.974；三个 LLM-as-judge 保持较高 precision，约 0.81 到 0.94，但 recall 波动很大，只有 0.06 到 0.65。同一批响应会因 judge 选择得到不同 ASR。无害 wrapper 可使每个 LLM judge 在 57% 到 100% 的样本上翻转判定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the automated judges used to compute jailbreak attack success rate are calibrated and robust to adversarial presentation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. It challenges a core measurement practice in jailbreak and prompt-injection work, with implications for safety post-training, red teaming, and the reproducibility of ASR claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set. It compares dedicated safety classifiers and prompted LLM judges against human majority labels, then attacks the judges with benign wrappers and prepended refusal-like framing that leave the harmful content intact.
summary_en.experiments: The dedicated classifier over-flags, with precision 0.835 and recall 0.974. Three LLM judges maintain high precision, from 0.81 to 0.94, but show unstable recall from 0.06 to 0.65. The same completions can yield different ASR depending on the judge. Benign wrappers flip LLM-judge decisions between 57% and 100% of the time.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测里 ASR judge 的地基被敲了一下；只看校准表和 wrapper attack 结果就够。
recommendation.en: This pokes at the foundation of ASR-based safety evaluation; read the calibration table and wrapper-attack results.

paper.title: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant approach to scalable evaluation in NLP pipelines, yet judges themselves carry systematic biases that raw accuracy hides: they favor responses placed in slot A (position bias), they prefer longer responses regardless of quality (verbosity bias), and their reliability degrades sharply in lower-resource languages. We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes -- position bias, verbosity b

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 LLM-as-a-judge 的可靠性审计问题：一个 judge 模型即使在配对选择上有不错的原始准确率，也可能同时存在位置偏置、冗长偏置、顺序不一致和跨语言退化。论文的重点不是提升 judge，而是提供一个不依赖人工偏好标注的测试框架，把这些隐藏失效模式显式量化。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 研究的直接启发在于：LLM judge 已经被大量用于偏好数据构造、RLHF/RLAIF、模型选择和自动评测，如果 judge 在低资源语言或长回答上存在系统性偏置，训练信号会被污染。BabelJudge 的贡献偏评测基础设施，量级不在模型能力提升，而在提供一个可复用的可靠性诊断工具。它提醒研究者不要只看 judge accuracy，还要看 order consistency、position bias 和 verbosity susceptibility 这类会影响训练数据质量的指标。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 gold-labelling by degradation。给定高质量参考回答 r，对它施加受控退化得到 p，并把 gold label 定义为偏好 r。这样可以从任意参考语料自动生成配对评测样本，不需要人工偏好标注。框架设计了 5 类语言无关扰动，基于空白 token、句子分隔符和数字模式操作，因此可以直接迁移到多语言场景。其中 repeat_pad 是冗长偏置探针：扰动答案更长但质量更差，如果 judge 偏好它，就说明 judge 在奖励长度而不是质量。每个样本以 ref-first 和 pert-first 两种顺序提交给 judge，从而直接测量位置偏置和顺序一致性。最终指标不是简单平均，而是把准确率、位置偏置惩罚、冗长偏置惩罚、顺序一致性组合成 multiplicative reliability score。这个设计有明确取舍：如果一个 judge 准确率高但偏置大，乘法门控会比加法平均给出更低分，更适合暴露评测风险。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 作为 judge，在 Apple Silicon 上本地运行。数据来自 Aya 多语言数据集，每种语言抽取 10 条参考回答，覆盖英语、印地语、阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语。5 种扰动、2 个严重程度、2 种展示顺序，对每种语言形成约 200 次 judge 调用，四种语言约 800 次调用。结果显示，宏平均 accuracy 为 0.770，但宏平均 reliability 只有 0.614，差距达到 15.6 个百分点。斯瓦希里语 reliability 为 0.550，比印地语 0.714 低 23 个百分点；但两者 accuracy 差距只有 17.5 个百分点，分别为 0.660 和 0.835。主要问题来自 order consistency：斯瓦希里语只有 0.480，说明交换候选答案顺序后，判决接近随机翻转。英语的 verbosity susceptibility 很低，为 0.075，说明该 judge 在英语 repeat_pad 样本上不太容易被更长但更差的回答误导。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 gold-labelling by degradation 的构造逻辑、repeat_pad 为什么能隔离冗长偏置、双顺序评测如何分离位置偏置和顺序一致性。Results 部分建议看 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，对比 accuracy 与 reliability 的差异，以及不同语言上的退化来源。如果关心自动评测或偏好数据质量，值得细看 composite reliability score 的乘法惩罚设计；如果只关心模型能力提升，可以跳过 agent trajectory 扩展和工程适配细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses reliability auditing for LLM-as-a-judge systems. A judge can show reasonable pairwise accuracy while still suffering from position bias, verbosity bias, order inconsistency, and cross-lingual degradation. The goal is not to train a better judge, but to build a reusable audit harness that exposes these hidden failure modes without human preference labels.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training is signal quality. LLM judges are now used in preference data generation, RLHF/RLAIF pipelines, model selection, and automated evaluation. If the judge systematically favors slot A, longer answers, or high-resource languages, the resulting supervision can be biased. BabelJudge is best viewed as evaluation infrastructure. Its contribution is to move judge assessment beyond raw accuracy toward reliability metrics that are more predictive of whether the judge can safely be used as a training or evaluation signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is gold-labelling by degradation. Starting from a high-quality reference response, the framework applies a controlled degradation to create a worse response, and defines the gold label as preferring the original reference. This produces pairwise items from any reference corpus without human annotation. The perturbations are designed to be language-agnostic, relying on whitespace tokens, sentence boundaries, and digit patterns. The repeat_pad perturbation is the verbosity-bias probe: it makes the degraded response longer while keeping it strictly worse, so a preference for the padded response indicates a length bias. Each item is evaluated in both reference-first and perturbed-first orders, which makes position bias and order consistency directly measurable. The final reliability score combines accuracy with multiplicative penalties for bias and inconsistency, intentionally lowering the score of judges that are accurate but unstable or biased.
summary_en.experiments: The experiment audits mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit, a quantized Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct judge running locally through MLX on Apple Silicon. The data is sampled from Aya, with 10 reference responses per language across English, Hindi, Arabic, and Swahili. Five perturbation types, two severity levels, and two presentation orders yield about 200 judge calls per language, or roughly 800 total calls. The macro accuracy is 0.770, while macro reliability is 0.614, a 15.6-point gap. Swahili reliability is 0.550, 23 points below Hindi at 0.714, even though the accuracy gap is smaller: 0.660 versus 0.835. The main driver is order consistency. For Swahili it is 0.480, meaning the judge’s decision nearly flips at random when the answer order is swapped. English verbosity susceptibility is reported as low, 0.075, suggesting the audited judge is not easily fooled by longer degraded answers in English.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the methodology: the degradation-based labelling scheme, the repeat_pad probe for verbosity bias, and the two-order design for separating position bias from answer quality. In the results, Figure 2 and Figure 3 are the useful parts: they show why accuracy and reliability diverge, and which failure modes dominate per language. For readers building automated evaluation or preference-data pipelines, the composite reliability score is worth a closer look. The agent-trajectory extension and backend adapters can be read lightly unless they match an immediate engineering need.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 构造即可；若你用 judge 过滤 RL 数据，这类偏差会直接变成训练信号噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the metric construction; if judges filter your RL data, these biases become training-signal noise rather than evaluation trivia.

paper.title: StatABench: Dataset and Framework for Evaluating Statistical Analysis Capabilities of LLMs
paper.abstract: Statistical analysis is a broad, complex field requiring both domain knowledge and tool proficiency. While prior work has evaluated large language models (LLMs) in this domain, existing benchmarks remain limited in scope and format. To bridge this gap, we introduce StatABench (Statistical AnalysisBenchmark), a benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs' statistical analysis capabilities. StatABench comprises two complementary components: Stat-Closed, containing 404 questions across 18 stat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个评测缺口：现有 LLM 统计分析 benchmark 往往只测概念题，或者只测一般性的工具调用，难以覆盖真实统计工作里“选方法—调参数—跑工具—解释结果—写成分析结论”这一整条链路。论文把问题拆成两个层面：一是封闭式统计知识与程序化操作能力，二是开放式、接近建模竞赛的端到端统计分析能力。更具体地说，它要回答的不是“模型会不会背统计学”，而是“模型能不能在有工具的前提下，稳定完成真实统计分析任务”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要不在于提出新训练方法，而在于提供了一个较干净的能力切面：统计分析是典型的高知识密度、强工具依赖、强程序约束任务，能较好地区分语言表面流畅性与真正的结构化分析能力。这个 benchmark 的价值有三点。第一，它把工具使用纳入评测主轴，而不是附属设置，这对研究“预训练是否学到可操作知识”很有帮助。第二，它显式做了 contamination 缓解，虽然不能完全排除泄漏，但比直接拼装公开题库更严谨。第三，结果显示即便强模型在封闭题和开放题上都远未饱和，说明当前模型在统计方法选择、参数设定、结果解释和长链分析上仍有明显短板。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这类 benchmark 可以用来检验模型是否真的学会了可执行分析，而不是只会生成像样的答案。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成两个 benchmark 资产和一套统一执行框架。Stat-Closed 包含 404 道题，覆盖 18 个统计主题，题型包括选择、填空、决策和 practical application。这里的关键设计不是题量，而是把 practical application 做成“问题 + 数据集 + 工具参数真值”的三元组，让模型必须调用 SAToolKit 才能完成任务。SAToolKit 提供 35 个可调用统计函数，覆盖描述统计、假设检验、回归、因果、生存分析、高维分析等主题。这样评测的不是自由发挥，而是：模型能否选对函数、填对参数、理解输出。

数据构建上，作者从教材、已有 benchmark、公开考试与资源库中收集题目，然后做 modify-and-verify 流程来降低污染风险。具体做法是先用 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 试答；若题目被正确答出，则视为潜在泄漏样本，人工改写题干、扰动选项、翻转真假条件等，再次验证，只有至少一个模型失败或经专家确认质量足够的样本才保留。这个流程并不完美，但比简单去重更贴近“语义层面的去污染”。

Stat-Open 则是 30 个开放式统计建模任务，来自 MCM/ICM、CUMCM、MAS 等建模竞赛，要求完成数据清洗、探索分析、建模和结构化报告生成。这里作者没有用标准答案打分，而是采用结构化报告输出 + LLM-as-Judge 评审协议，并强调做了人机一致性验证。执行层面，封闭题主要通过 LangChain MCP 接 SAToolKit，也额外比较了 Qwen Agent、CrewAI、AutoGen、Smolagents 等 agent 框架；开放题则用不同建模框架生成报告，再交给 judge 打分。整体上，这篇工作更像是在构建一个“统计分析能力测试台”，而不是单纯出一套题。
summary.experiments:
关键结果有几组。第一，Stat-Closed 上，即便 GPT-5.1 也只有 68.6% 准确率，最强开源模型 Qwen2.5-72B 为 60.6%。这说明在有工具可用的情况下，统计分析仍不是接近解决的问题。第二，Stat-Open 上，最佳 agent framework 的平均分是 61.86，说明开放式端到端建模更难，瓶颈不只是知识，还包括任务分解、工具编排和结果表达。第三，作者使用 Friedman test 给出显著性结果 p = 2.87 × 10^-9，说明不同模型/框架之间差异不是噪声。

从全文设定看，更值得注意的是实验结构而不是单个分数。作者比较了多种 agent 框架，意味着同一底模在不同 orchestration 下表现会变；这对 post-train 和 agent system 研究很重要，因为它提示“能力上限”与“系统实现”是耦合的。另一个值得留意的点是题型分层：选择/填空类更接近知识检索，practical application 更接近真实分析，开放题则进一步要求长程规划和报告生成。若全文表格里给出了分 topic 或分题型结果，阅读时应重点看哪些主题掉点最明显，例如因果推断、生存分析、高维统计这类通常更能暴露模型的概念边界与工具调用错误模式。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。优先看四部分。第一，看 benchmark 设计章节里 Stat-Closed 与 Stat-Open 的任务定义，弄清楚它到底在测什么，尤其是 practical application 和 open-ended task 的边界。第二，看数据构建与 contamination 缓解流程，重点是 modify-and-verify 算法和专家复核规则，这决定 benchmark 的可信度。第三，看 SAToolKit 的函数覆盖范围与接口形式，判断它是在测统计能力，还是在测某个工具 API 的熟练度。第四，看主结果表和按题型/主题拆分的结果，关注模型失败是因为不会选方法、不会设参数，还是不会解释输出。

预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若只想判断是否值得纳入自己的评测集，重点看 Figure 2、任务样例、主结果表，以及附录里关于数据来源和 judge 验证的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete evaluation gap: existing LLM benchmarks for statistics either test textbook-style knowledge or generic tool use, but rarely the full workflow of statistical analysis—choosing a method, configuring it correctly, executing tools, interpreting outputs, and writing a coherent conclusion. The benchmark is designed around two levels of difficulty: closed-form statistical reasoning with executable operations, and open-ended end-to-end modeling tasks that resemble real statistical work.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining research is indirect but real. Statistical analysis is a useful stress test for whether a model has acquired operational knowledge rather than fluent surface patterns. The benchmark matters for three reasons. First, tool use is treated as a first-class part of the task, not an auxiliary setting. That makes it relevant for studying whether pretraining yields actionable procedural knowledge. Second, the authors make a nontrivial effort to reduce contamination, which is important for any benchmark built from public educational material. Third, the results show that strong models are still far from reliable on method selection, parameter specification, output interpretation, and long-horizon analytical workflows. For researchers working on the pretrain/post-train interface, this is a useful evaluation asset for checking whether models can actually perform structured analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work consists of two benchmark components plus a unified execution setup. Stat-Closed contains 404 questions spanning 18 statistical topics, with multiple formats: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, decision-making, and practical application. The practical-application subset is the key design choice: each instance is a triplet of statistical question, dataset, and ground-truth function parameters, so the model must interact with the provided toolkit rather than answer purely in prose.

The toolkit, SAToolKit, exposes 35 callable statistical functions covering descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, survival analysis, high-dimensional analysis, and more. This lets the benchmark evaluate three distinct abilities in a controlled way: selecting the right procedure, specifying valid parameters, and interpreting the returned results.

For data construction, the authors aggregate material from textbooks, prior benchmarks, and public exam-style resources. To mitigate contamination, they use a modify-and-verify pipeline: questions answered correctly by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct are flagged as potentially leaked, then manually perturbed by rewriting stems, changing distractors, shuffling options, or inverting conditions. Only items that at least one model subsequently fails, or that experts explicitly validate as high quality, are retained. This is not a formal guarantee against leakage, but it is stronger than naive collection from public sources.

Stat-Open contains 30 open-ended tasks adapted from mathematical modeling competitions such as MCM/ICM, CUMCM, and MAS. These require end-to-end data cleaning, exploratory analysis, model building, and structured report generation. Since there is no single gold answer, the authors use structured outputs and an LLM-as-Judge protocol, with claimed human alignment validation. On the execution side, Stat-Closed is run mainly through LangChain MCP with SAToolKit, and the paper also compares several agent frameworks including Qwen Agent, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Smolagents.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline numbers are straightforward. On Stat-Closed, GPT-5.1 reaches only 68.6% accuracy, while the strongest open model reported, Qwen2.5-72B, gets 60.6%. On Stat-Open, the best agent framework achieves an average score of 61.86. The paper also reports a Friedman test with p = 2.87 × 10^-9, indicating that the performance differences across systems are statistically significant.

More interesting than the absolute numbers is the structure of the evaluation. The benchmark separates easier knowledge-centric formats from practical tool-based tasks and then from open-ended modeling. That layered design helps identify where models fail: conceptual recall, procedural execution, or long-horizon analytical planning. The comparison across agent frameworks is also informative, because it shows that the same underlying model can move noticeably depending on orchestration and tool-calling setup. If the full tables include per-topic or per-format breakdowns, those are worth checking carefully—topics like causal inference, survival analysis, and high-dimensional statistics are likely where conceptual and operational weaknesses become most visible.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on four parts. First, read the task definitions for Stat-Closed and Stat-Open to understand exactly what is being measured. Second, inspect the contamination-mitigation pipeline; that is central to benchmark credibility. Third, look at the SAToolKit function inventory and interface design to judge whether the benchmark is testing statistical competence or mostly API handling. Fourth, read the main result tables and any breakdown by topic or question type to see where current models fail.

About 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main value. If you only need to decide whether to adopt it as an evaluation asset, prioritize the benchmark construction section, the modify-and-verify procedure, example tasks, and the main result tables.

recommendation.zh: 偏 benchmark，不直接推进 pretrain；知道“连 GPT-5.1 做统计分析也不稳”就够了，除非你在做 tool-use eval，否则正文可不细读。
recommendation.en: Mostly a benchmark paper, not a pretraining lever; it is enough to note that even GPT-5.1 is far from saturated on statistical analysis unless you specifically care about tool-use evaluation.

paper.title: Counsel: A Meta-Evaluation Dataset for Agentic Tasks
paper.abstract: As agentic systems tackle increasingly complex multi-step tasks, evaluating their trajectories presents a major bottleneck - human annotation of a single trajectory on popular agentic benchmarks can take hours, making it difficult to scale evaluations for measuring performance or curating training data. This has driven widespread reliance on automated approaches such as LLM-as-a-judge (LLMJ) to critique agents at the process and outcome-levels at scale, however, the soundness of LLMJ critiques o

summary.core_problem: 当前Agent轨迹评估广泛依赖LLM-as-judge生成过程级批评，但缺乏公开的元评测数据集衡量这类批评本身的质量；现有元评估仅对比LLM judge最终打分与人类标注的一致性，无法判断错误定位是否准确、解释逻辑是否合理，限制了judge模型的迭代优化。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent评测领域的元评估数据空白，可直接用于评估LLM judge的过程批评质量、训练元judge过滤低质量反馈、作为监督信号优化judge模型，对大模型后训练阶段自动化反馈信号质量提升、Agent训练数据筛选工作有基础支撑作用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了首个面向Agent任务的公开元评测数据集Counsel，覆盖两类主流Agent场景：τ-bench的多轮客服交互、DA-Code的代码生成。数据采集分两步：首先使用开源LLM judge对开源Agent的执行轨迹逐step生成批评，标注错误位置与原因；再由人类标注员对LLM生成的批评做元标注，分别标记错误定位是否准确、解释是否合理。数据集支持三类核心用途：评估judge的批评质量、训练元judge筛选高价值批评、直接监督优化judge模型。
summary.experiments: 人类标注员间一致性达到Krippendorff’s alpha 0.78，标注质量可靠。跨模型测试显示，judge基础能力越强、推理投入越高，与人类元标注的一致性越高；当前表现最好的开源judge错误定位准确率达88%，但解释合理性准确率仅为65%，说明现有judge的批评推理质量仍有明显提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议用10分钟读完核心内容，重点关注数据集构建流程、标注维度设计，以及现有judge模型的表现统计；从事Agent评测或LLM-as-judge优化方向的读者可额外关注数据集的字段设计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Widespread adoption of LLM-as-judge for process-level evaluation of agent trajectories lacks public meta-evaluation resources to measure the quality of LLM-generated critiques; existing meta-evaluation efforts only compare final score agreement with human labels, without assessing error localization accuracy or explanation soundness, creating a bottleneck for judge model improvement.
summary_en.importance: Counsel fills a core gap in agent evaluation infrastructure, enabling direct measurement, optimization, and filtering of LLM judge outputs. It provides a foundation for improving automated feedback signal quality in post-training and curating high-quality agent training data at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: Counsel is the first public meta-evaluation dataset for agent tasks, covering two common agent domains: multi-turn customer support interactions from τ-bench, and code generation tasks from DA-Code. Data is collected in two stages: open-weight LLM judges first generate step-level critiques (error location + supporting explanation) for trajectories produced by open-weight agents; human annotators then provide meta-labels for each critique, marking whether errors are correctly localized and whether explanations are logically sound. The dataset supports three core use cases: evaluating judge critique quality, training meta-judges to filter low-quality outputs, and providing direct supervision for judge model optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Human annotators achieve high inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.78), confirming annotation reliability. Cross-model evaluation shows stronger base model capability and higher reasoning effort correlate with higher human agreement; the top-performing open-weight judge reaches 88% agreement on error localization, but only 65% agreement on explanation correctness, indicating substantial remaining room for improvement in critique reasoning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~10 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction pipeline, annotation dimension design, and aggregate performance statistics of existing judge models. Readers working on agent evaluation or LLM-as-judge optimization can review the dataset schema for field design details.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据定义和标注一致性即可；它提醒训练 agent critic 前先量 judge 噪声，不然 RL/SFT 信号会很脏。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset schema and agreement analysis; the useful lesson is to measure judge noise before using agent critiques as SFT or RL signals.

paper.title: Jury Duty: Calibration and Orientation Failures in MLLM-as-a-Judge Under Cultural Ambiguity
paper.abstract: MLLM-as-a-Judge is conventionally validated by agreement with human annotations, but this metric is undefined when the human pool is culturally heterogeneous. We introduce VOIR DIRE, a multimodal benchmark of 626 culturally paired image--prompt artifacts spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, and architecture, with annotator pools that are within-pool reliable (a = 0.86/0.74) but cross-pool divergent on evaluation (Q1 r = -0.12). Across six MLLMs, the bias decomposes i

summary.core_problem: MLLM-as-a-Judge的常规验证方式是测量模型输出与人类标注的一致性，但这类验证不区分标注群体的文化背景。在涉及偏好、审美、价值判断的歧义场景下，不同文化群体的评价存在系统性分歧，现有流程会默认将单一群体的偏好作为「标准答案」，既无法识别裁判模型内化的文化偏向，也会将这类偏向伪装成客观评分，通过RLAIF、评测榜单传导为下一代模型的训练信号偏差。
summary.importance: MLLM/LLM-as-a-Judge的输出已经成为RLAIF训练信号、自动评测榜单的核心组成部分，裁判端的系统偏差会沿着训练闭环逐轮放大，而非孤立的评测噪声。多模态场景下视觉符号承载的文化属性比纯文本更隐蔽，此前对模型对齐偏向的讨论多集中在生成端，这项工作明确了评判端偏差的传导路径，以及偏差的两个可分离来源，提示仅靠单一人标注池的一致性无法验证裁判模型的可靠性，对评测协议设计、对齐训练信号质量控制有直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: VOIR DIRE多模态评测基准包含626组中美文化配对的图像-评价提示题项，覆盖饮食、时尚、建筑与符号三个领域。每对题项使用同一图像生成模型、完全匹配的参数（构图、光线、比例、风格）生成，仅文化符号存在差异，排除图像质量、美学特征等混淆变量对评分的影响。标注由两个独立的、文化背景同质的标注组完成（美国、中国大陆各5名双文化流利标注者），组内标注一致性较高（克朗巴赫α=0.86/0.74），但组间对评价类问题的判断相关性极低（Pearson r=-0.12），证明题项确实存在稳定的文化分歧而非标注噪声。基于该基准，MLLM裁判的偏差被分解为两类可分离的失效模式：一是校准失效，打分集中在正向区间，压缩量表的动态范围，极少使用低分；二是定向失效，模型默认偏向某一文化的评价规范，无法对异文化场景给出符合对应群体预期的判断。
summary.experiments: 在6个主流MLLM上的测试得到三个核心结论：（1）两个文化组对图像事实内容的识别一致性很高（76%~85%的题项内容判断一致），但在好坏、适当性这类评价维度上分歧极大；（2）所有被测模型都同时存在两类失效：打分集中在正向区间的校准问题，以及与模型开发所属地区对应的稳定文化定向偏向；（3）添加文化人设提示、使用目标文化的ICL示例仅能小幅减弱定向偏向，无法消除跨文化评价分歧，说明这类偏向是模型在预训练和对齐阶段内化到权重中的，而非提示可以调整的表层应答习惯。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分关于裁判偏差沿训练闭环传导的逻辑、两类失效模式的拆分，以及提示无法消除定向偏向的核心结论。可跳过标注流程细节、统计鲁棒性检验部分，除非直接从事裁判模型开发或评测设计工作。预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional validation of MLLM-as-a-Judge systems measures agreement between model outputs and human annotations, but does not account for the cultural composition of the annotator pool. On preference-sensitive tasks involving aesthetics, appropriateness, or value judgments, evaluative judgments diverge systematically across cultural groups. Existing validation pipelines treat a single group's preferences as ground truth, failing to detect cultural biases internalized in judge models — biases that are embedded in scalar scores, then propagated into RLAIF training signals and leaderboard ground truth for subsequent model training cycles.
summary_en.importance: Outputs from LLM/MLLM judges now form a core component of RLAIF training signals and automated evaluation pipelines, so systematic bias in judges does not remain isolated to evaluation, but amplifies across successive training loops. Multimodal settings carry particular risk, as visual symbols encode dense, often unrecognized cultural meaning that is invisible to text-only bias audits. Prior work on alignment bias has largely focused on model generation; this work identifies a separate bias pathway through evaluation, and decomposes judge bias into two separable components, demonstrating that single-pool human agreement is insufficient to validate judge reliability. The findings have direct implications for evaluation protocol design and alignment training signal quality control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The VOIR DIRE multimodal benchmark contains 626 culturally paired image-prompt items spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, architecture, and cultural symbols. Each concept pair is generated with the same image model under matched parameters (composition, lighting, aspect ratio, style), so only cultural cues differ across pairs, eliminating confounds from image quality or aesthetic signatures that could independently drive rating differences. Annotations are collected from two independent, culturally homogeneous annotator groups (five U.S.-based, five mainland China-based biculturally fluent annotators), with verified high within-group agreement (Cronbach's α = 0.86 / 0.74) but near-zero cross-group correlation on evaluative judgments (Pearson r = -0.12), confirming stable cultural divergence rather than annotation noise. Using this benchmark, MLLM judge bias is decomposed into two separate failure modes: calibration failure, where scores are compressed into the positive range of the scale with minimal use of low scores, reducing dynamic range; and orientation failure, where the model systematically defaults to the evaluative norms of one cultural group, failing to match the judgments of other groups on culturally specific items.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across six mainstream MLLMs yield three core results: (1) Annotators from both cultural groups show high agreement on factual content depicted in images (76–85% consensus on content identification), but near-zero agreement on evaluative judgments of quality or appropriateness; (2) All tested models exhibit both failure modes: compressed positive score distributions, and stable orientation bias aligned with the regional origin of the model's development; (3) Cultural persona prompting and in-context examples drawn from the target cultural group reduce but do not eliminate orientation bias, indicating these biases are encoded in model weights during pretraining and alignment, rather than being superficial response tendencies adjustable via prompting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core argument and findings. Focus on the causal pathway linking judge bias to propagated training signal in RLAIF and benchmarks, the two-component decomposition of judge failure, and the finding that prompting cannot resolve orientation bias. Skip granular annotation protocol details and statistical robustness checks unless working directly on judge model development or evaluation design. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 裁判评测方法学的重要警告：文化异质时“和人一致”这个指标本身无效，关注§4的偏差分解方法和Fig.6里ICL反而加重偏差的部分。
recommendation.en: A critical methodological warning for LLM-as-a-judge: under cultural heterogeneity human-agreement metric itself is invalid; focus on §4 bias decomposition and Fig.6 where ICL worsens bias.

paper.title: Reliability without Validity: A Systematic, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge Models Across Agreement, Consistency, and Bias
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant evaluation paradigm for language models, but judge validation in practice relies on exact-match agreement, a metric that does not correct for chance and systematically overstates discriminative ability. We present the largest systematic evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge to date: 21 judges from nine providers across MT-Bench, JudgeBench, and RewardBench, evaluated under three protocols (agreement, consistency, bias audit) over 118 runs and approximately 541,000 i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM-as-a-Judge 的验证问题：当前很多评测管线用 exact match 或 raw agreement 来说明 judge 与人类一致，但这些指标没有扣除随机一致性，会系统性高估 judge 的判别能力。论文进一步指出，judge 的高复测一致性也不等于有效性，因为同一个偏差可以被稳定重复。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏评测方法的工作，但对预训练和 post-train 都有直接影响。现代基座研发越来越依赖自动评测来筛模型、调数据、做 reward model 诊断、比较 SFT/RL 版本。如果 judge 的 headline metric 不可靠，训练决策会被错误排序牵引。论文的贡献不是提出一个新 judge，而是把 judge validation 从“看起来和人类一致”推进到 chance-corrected agreement、跨 benchmark 可迁移性、复测一致性和偏差审计的联合检查。量级上，它覆盖 21 个模型、9 个 provider、3 个 benchmark、118 次运行和约 54.1 万次判断，是一个较系统的 judge 元评测。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案由三层组成。第一层是模型覆盖：作者选取 21 个通用 LLM judge，来自 9 个 provider，按能力和成本分成三个 tier，参数规模从 8B 到 100B 以上，并包含 2026 年 4 月的较新模型。第二层是 benchmark 覆盖：MT-Bench 提供 2391 个带专家人类标注的 pairwise comparison；JudgeBench 提供 350 个覆盖数学、代码、创意写作和分析的客观正确性条目；RewardBench 提供 2981 个 chosen-versus-rejected pair，并对每个 item 做位置随机化，避免 chosen 总在同一侧。第三层是协议设计：agreement protocol 做单次判断，报告 Cohen’s κ、Krippendorff’s α 和去 tie 的 exact match；consistency protocol 对每个 item 独立运行 3–5 次，关闭缓存，并同时测试 AB 与 BA 顺序，报告 test-retest reliability、self-consistency 和 position flip rate；bias-audit protocol 用 AB+BA 加 response length 分析，测 position bias 和 verbosity bias。关键区别在于，论文没有把 judge 当作一个普通分类器只看准确率，而是把“是否能稳定、无偏、可迁移地模拟评价标准”拆成多个可诊断维度。
summary.experiments: 实验在 2026 年 3–4 月的五周内完成，共 118 个 evaluation runs，约 541,000 次单独判断，temperature 设为 0；一致性实验关闭 response caching，以避免重复调用返回缓存答案。核心结果很清楚。第一，MT-Bench 上所有 21 个 judge 都出现 kappa deflation：exact match 相比 Cohen’s κ 高估 33.8–41.3 个百分点，平均高估 38.6 个百分点。即使表现最好的 Gemini 3.1 Pro，exact match 为 0.849，κ 只有 0.511，差距仍为 33.8 个百分点；所有 Tier 3 模型的 Δκ 都不低于 30 个百分点。第二，judge 排名不能跨 benchmark 直接迁移，模型在不同 benchmark 上的排名最多移动 14 位。第三，论文报告了 consistency–bias paradox：高 test-retest reliability 可能和严重 position bias 同时存在，说明“稳定”不等于“有效”。第四，verbosity bias 在这批模型中显著减弱，所有 21 个模型的相关指标都低于 0.011，和 2023 年文献中 20–40% 方差可由长度解释的现象不同。第五，JudgeBench 的区分度明显强于 MT-Bench，κ spread 为 60.4 个百分点，而 MT-Bench 为 13.5 个百分点，约为 4.5 倍。这说明 benchmark 本身的标签分布和任务结构会强烈影响 judge 评估的分辨率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中的五个主发现，尤其是 kappa deflation、rank non-transferability 和 consistency–bias paradox。然后看 Methodology，重点关注三套 protocol 的定义，因为这些比具体模型排名更可复用。Table 1 用来了解 judge 覆盖范围；Table 2 和 Figure 1 是理解 exact match 与 Cohen’s κ 差异的关键；偏差审计部分适合和内部评测管线对照。最值得深挖的是两个问题：第一，为什么 exact match 在 A/B/Tie 或类别不均衡场景中会高估 judge；第二，为什么关闭缓存、AB/BA 对称评测、chance-corrected metrics 应该成为自动评测系统的默认配置。预计精读时间 1.5–2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM-as-a-Judge systems are actually valid evaluators, not merely repeatable ones. Its central claim is that exact-match agreement, the common validation metric, overstates judge quality because it does not correct for chance agreement. High reliability can also be misleading when a model repeats the same positional or format bias consistently.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation paper, but it has direct consequences for foundation-model development. Automated judges are now used to compare checkpoints, tune post-training recipes, filter data, score synthetic instruction data, and diagnose reward models. If the judge is validated with a weak metric, model selection and training decisions can be misranked. The paper’s main contribution is a large-scale judge validation protocol combining chance-corrected agreement, consistency, cross-benchmark transfer, and bias audits. The scale is substantial: 21 judges from nine providers, three benchmarks, 118 runs, and about 541,000 individual judgments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study is organized around three components. First, it covers 21 general-purpose LLM judges across nine providers and three tiers, ranging from 8B-class systems to models above 100B parameters, including April 2026 frontier-generation systems. Second, it evaluates them on MT-Bench, JudgeBench, and RewardBench. MT-Bench contributes 2,391 pairwise comparisons with expert human labels; JudgeBench contributes 350 items across math, coding, creative writing, and analysis with objective correctness labels; RewardBench contributes 2,981 chosen-versus-rejected pairs with per-item position randomization. Third, it uses three protocols. The agreement protocol reports Cohen’s κ, Krippendorff’s α, and tie-excluded exact match. The consistency protocol runs each item independently 3–5 times with response caching disabled and with both AB and BA orderings, measuring test-retest reliability, self-consistency, and position flip rate. The bias-audit protocol uses paired AB/BA presentations and response-length analysis to estimate position and verbosity bias. The important design choice is to separate accuracy-like agreement from repeatability and bias, rather than collapsing judge quality into a single raw agreement number.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments were run over five weeks in March and April 2026, with temperature set to zero. The full procedure produced 118 evaluation runs and roughly 541,000 judgments. The main empirical result is universal kappa deflation on MT-Bench: across all 21 judges, exact match exceeds Cohen’s κ by 33.8 to 41.3 percentage points, with a mean gap of 38.6 points. Even the best chance-corrected judge, Gemini 3.1 Pro, has exact match of 0.849 but κ of 0.511, a 33.8-point gap. All Tier 3 models show Δκ of at least 30 points. Rankings are not stable across benchmarks, with models moving by as many as 14 positions. The paper also reports a consistency-bias paradox: some judges can be highly reliable under repeated testing while still showing strong position bias. Verbosity bias appears much lower than in earlier judge studies, with all 21 models below 0.011, contrasting with 2023 reports where length explained 20–40% of variance. JudgeBench separates models more sharply than MT-Bench, with a 60.4-point κ spread versus 13.5 points on MT-Bench, about a 4.5× difference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the introduction’s five findings, especially kappa deflation, cross-benchmark rank instability, and the consistency-bias paradox. Then spend time on the methodology, because the three-protocol design is more reusable than the individual model rankings. Table 1 clarifies judge coverage; Table 2 and Figure 1 are central for understanding the gap between exact match and Cohen’s κ. The bias-audit sections are worth comparing against any internal LLM evaluation pipeline. The key technical lessons are that chance-corrected metrics, AB/BA position swaps, cache-disabled repeated runs, and separate bias reporting should be defaults for serious judge evaluation. A careful read should take about 1.5–2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 会改变内部评测默认值：别再只报 exact-match judge agreement，应立刻加 kappa、位置偏差和跨集排名稳定性审计。
recommendation.en: This should change internal eval defaults: stop reporting only exact-match judge agreement, and add kappa, position-bias, and cross-benchmark rank-stability audits.

paper.title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Bias Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
paper.abstract: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their systematic evaluation biases propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator biases spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator bias profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-based), we measure the Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3 and find that evaluator biases consistent

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多 Agent 系统中充当 evaluator 时，自身评价偏差会如何沿 Agent 交互网络传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评估可靠性分析与形式化建模。它把“LLM-as-judge 的偏差”从单点误差扩展到网络传播问题，对多 Agent 评审、辩论、委员会式决策有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contagion Networks，用跨 Agent 传染矩阵 Gamma_3 度量评价偏差传播强度，并用谱半径 rho(Gamma_N) 划分传播、临界、抑制三类 regime。方法偏分析框架，不是新的 Agent 训练或推理架构。
summary.experiments: 在受控 3-Agent 设置中使用 DeepSeek-chat，构造 structured、balanced、evidence-based 三类 evaluator bias profile。测得同模型 Agent 间 contagion coefficient 为 0.157 到 0.352；相比 prior work MM-EPC 中跨模型约 0.85 到 1.3 的系数弱 3-5 倍。将 evaluator committee size 从 k=1 增至 k=3 后，有效传染下降 72.4%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how systematic LLM evaluator biases propagate through interacting agents in multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an analysis framework for evaluator reliability in agent networks. It moves LLM-as-judge bias from a single-node issue to a network-level propagation problem, which is relevant for debate, committee evaluation, and multi-agent review pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Contagion Networks and a cross-agent contagion matrix Gamma_3 to quantify bias transfer. The spectral radius rho(Gamma_N) is used to define propagation regimes. The work is primarily a diagnostic and formalization effort rather than a new agent training method.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled experiment uses three DeepSeek-chat agents with structured, balanced, and evidence-based evaluator bias profiles. Same-model agents show contagion coefficients between 0.157 and 0.352, about 3-5x weaker than the cross-model coefficients around 0.85-1.3 reported in MM-EPC. Increasing the evaluator committee from k=1 to k=3 reduces effective contagion by 72.4%.

recommendation.zh: 可看 abstract 和实验表；小规模 setup 偏窄，但“同模型偏差传播弱于跨模型”这个信号值得记下。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and experiment table only; the setup is small, but the weaker same-model contagion signal is worth remembering.

paper.title: Benchmarking Agentic Review Systems
paper.abstract: A new class of agentic review systems are emerging as a remedy to the pressure placed on peer review systems by AI-assisted research, but it is unclear how they should be evaluated. We evaluate two open-source systems (OpenAIReview and coarse), one proprietary system (Reviewer3), and a zero-shot baseline, across six LLMs spanning frontier and efficient models. First, we study whether AI reviews on ICLR/NeurIPS papers track with papers' quality as approximated by external signals such as citation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个此前几乎没有被认真定义的问题：agentic review system 应该如何被系统性评测。难点不在于让模型给出一段审稿意见，而在于判断一个“审稿系统”是否真的具备审稿能力。这里的对象是完整系统，不是单次 prompt 的裸模型输出。系统里包含长文切分、上下文管理、多轮检查、评论聚合、引用定位等机制，因此不能只看通用 benchmark 或单条样例。作者把问题拆成三层：第一，系统能否对真实论文质量给出有区分度的信号；第二，系统能否在有明确 ground truth 的条件下发现具体错误；第三，真实用户在开放使用中是否觉得这些评论有帮助，以及主要失败模式是什么。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在“审稿”这个应用本身，而在于它提供了一套评测 agentic long-context system 的方法学。很多系统论文都声称多代理、分段审阅、结构化提示能提升复杂任务表现，但缺少把“系统设计”与“底层模型能力”分开的评测框架。这里给出的两类评测——质量代理信号相关性和可控扰动召回——对长文理解、错误定位、跨段推理、系统级 recall/precision 权衡都有参考价值。对做 pretrain 和 post-train 的人，这篇文章还给出一个很具体的观察：更强模型确实提升系统表现，但系统设计本身也能显著改变错误类型覆盖面，尤其是在长上下文、跨段 prose-level reasoning error 上。这说明很多复杂任务的上限不只由 base model 决定，也受 inference-time decomposition 和 context routing 影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，文章的核心不是提出一个新 reviewer，而是构建一套分层 benchmark，并用它比较 OpenAIReview、‘coarse、Reviewer3、以及 zero-shot baseline 在多种后端模型上的表现。OpenAIReview 的系统设计值得看，因为它代表了一类典型的 agentic long-document pipeline：先把整篇论文切成长度相近的 passages，再对每个 passage 做局部审阅，同时维护运行中的摘要或全局上下文，使后续 passage 的判断不完全局限于局部窗口；最后把评论与原文引用绑定并聚合成结构化 review。作者强调，这种 running summarization 对跨段的论证错误、错误 claim、实验设计问题更有帮助，因为这些问题往往不是一个局部 token span 能决定的。

评测设计分三块。第一块是真实论文质量代理评测。作者收集 ICLR/NeurIPS 论文，用 citations、accept/reject、reviewer scores 以及三者组合形成 paper quality proxy。然后在随机采样的低质量/高质量论文对上，比较系统是否给低质量论文提出更多评论，用 pairwise accuracy 衡量。这个设定并不要求系统显式输出分数，而是把“评论密度”当作弱质量信号。第二块是扰动 benchmark。作者从原本较好的论文出发，人工或半自动注入四类错误：局部数学编辑、错误 claim、faulty reasoning、实验设计或分析错误。这样就有了已知 ground truth 的 error spans / error types，可以直接测 recall。第三块是真实部署反馈。OpenAIReview 作为 web tool 对外开放，收集用户对评论的 like/dislike 和“已处理”反馈，用来观察 precision 问题是否会在真实使用中成为主要障碍。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。第一，评测对象是完整系统而不是裸 LLM。第二，既看开放世界的相关性信号，也看封闭世界的已知错误召回。第三，作者明确区分 recall 和 precision：系统在 benchmark 上可以抓到不少错误，但真实使用里用户最不满的是 false positive 和吹毛求疵，这个张力在 agentic system 里很常见。
summary.experiments:
结果里最重要的数字有几组。质量代理评测上，所有系统都高于随机水平，说明今天的 reviewer system 已经能从论文文本中提取一定质量信号。最强配置是 OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5，pairwise accuracy 达到 83.0%。整体区间大致在 66% 到 83% 之间，并且随底层模型能力增强而上升。这个趋势说明系统设计不是在“制造幻觉信号”，而是在放大模型已有但不稳定的审阅能力。

扰动 benchmark 上，最强配置同样是 OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5，能召回 71.6% 的注入错误。按错误类型看，OpenAIReview 相对 zero-shot baseline 的优势主要出现在 prose-level 错误，而不是局部数学 token 级错误。文中给出的代表性数字是 faulty reasoning 的召回从 36.8% 提升到 68.4%。这和它的分段审阅 + 运行摘要设计一致：如果错误依赖较长的论证链或跨段上下文，系统化审阅比单次通读 prompt 更占优；但如果只是一个局部公式符号被改错，系统优势就没那么大。

另一个很有信息量的结果是模型互补性。不同 backend 在 OpenAIReview 框架下会关注到不同段落、不同错误类型；把多个模型的评论并起来，综合 recall 可以到 83.3%，比单个 GPT-5.5 后端高 11.7 个点。这说明 reviewer task 的 error surface 不是单模型轻易覆盖的，ensemble 或 committee-style review 可能比继续堆单模型更有效。

真实部署部分，作者收集了 1,360 条 review，覆盖 1,100 篇论文。用户反馈总体偏正向，likes:dislikes 为 1.44:1，且不少评论被标记为已处理。负反馈分析显示，主要问题不是完全胡说，而是 precision 不够：误报、过度挑刺、价值较低的小问题占了大头。这一点和 benchmark 中偏重 recall 的设置形成互补，也提醒系统设计不能只追求“多抓错”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看引言和任务定义，确认作者到底在 benchmark 什么：不是“模型能不能像审稿人一样打分”，而是“系统能否稳定地产生有用、可定位、可操作的评论”。然后重点看两部分。

第一部分是质量代理评测的构造。要看清楚 pairwise accuracy 的定义、为什么用评论数量作为弱质量信号、以及 citations / acceptance / reviewer scores 这些 proxy 各自的偏差。这里值得思考的是：评论多不一定代表论文差，也可能代表系统更啰嗦，所以这个指标更适合做相对比较，不适合做绝对质量判断。

第二部分是 perturbation benchmark。这是全文最有方法价值的部分。重点看四类错误是如何注入的、ground truth 如何对齐、recall 如何计算、不同错误类型为什么难度不同。图 1 和相关主表最值得细读，因为它们把“系统设计提升了什么能力”讲得比较清楚。

如果时间有限，再看 OpenAIReview 的系统流程图，尤其是 passage-level review、running summary、comment aggregation 这几个模块。它们对应的是长文 agentic system 的常见设计模式。最后看部署反馈部分，理解 precision failure 的真实形态。这个部分对做 agent、judge、verifier、长文 QA 系统的人都很有参考价值。

值得深挖的点有三个：一是评论数作为质量 proxy 是否会偏向冗长系统；二是 recall/precision 如何联合优化，是否需要 verifier 或 comment dedup/filtering；三是多模型互补性来自能力差异还是随机性差异，这决定 ensemble 是否值得长期投入。
summary.authors_note: Chicago Human+AI Lab 相关工作，文中明确涉及 OpenAIReview 团队；其余作者与机构在给定内容里未完整列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a missing piece in the emerging literature on AI reviewing: how to evaluate an agentic review system as a system, rather than judging a raw LLM on a few review prompts. A reviewer pipeline includes document parsing, passage segmentation, context management, iterative checking, comment grounding, and aggregation. The central question is therefore not whether a model can write review-like text, but whether a full system can reliably detect quality signals and concrete errors in long scientific papers, and whether those comments remain useful in real deployment.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is methodological. The paper offers a clean evaluation template for long-context agentic systems where system design and model capability are entangled. The two main axes are especially useful: correlation with external quality proxies on real papers, and recall on a controlled perturbation benchmark with known ground truth. That combination is broadly relevant to judge systems, verifier systems, long-document reasoning pipelines, and any setup where decomposition and context routing matter. A practical takeaway is that stronger base models help, but system design changes what kinds of failures are recoverable, especially for discourse-level and cross-paragraph errors.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is primarily an evaluation framework, not a new review model. The authors benchmark two open systems, OpenAIReview and ‘coarse, one proprietary system, Reviewer3, and a zero-shot baseline across multiple backend LLMs. OpenAIReview is the most informative system to inspect because it represents a common agentic long-document pattern: split a paper into passages, review passages one at a time, maintain a running summary or global context, and aggregate grounded comments linked to quoted spans. That design is intended to preserve long-range coherence while keeping each local review step tractable.

The evaluation has three layers. First, a real-paper quality-proxy study on ICLR/NeurIPS papers. Since these systems do not necessarily output calibrated scores, the paper uses comment volume as a weak signal and asks whether lower-quality papers, as approximated by citations, acceptance decisions, reviewer scores, or a composite proxy, receive more comments than higher-quality papers in random pairwise comparisons. Second, a perturbation benchmark with explicit ground truth. Starting from otherwise good papers, the authors inject four categories of errors: local math edits, false claims, faulty reasoning, and experimental design or analysis errors, across eight arXiv subject areas. This allows direct measurement of error recall. Third, a public deployment study of OpenAIReview, collecting user feedback on real reviews to expose precision issues that offline recall benchmarks may miss.

Relative to prior work, three differences matter. It evaluates complete systems rather than naked models. It combines open-world proxy correlation with closed-world error detection. And it explicitly surfaces the recall-precision tension: systems can catch many issues offline while still frustrating users with false positives and low-value nitpicks.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result on the quality-proxy task is that every evaluated system performs above chance, suggesting that current reviewer systems do extract nontrivial quality signals from paper text. The best configuration, OpenAIReview with GPT-5.5, reaches 83.0% pairwise accuracy. Reported performance spans roughly 66% to 83% depending on system and backend model, with a clear trend that stronger models yield stronger quality discrimination.

On the perturbation benchmark, the strongest setup again is OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5, reaching 71.6% recall over injected errors. The gains over a zero-shot baseline are not uniform across error types. The largest improvements are on prose-level errors, especially faulty reasoning, where recall rises from 36.8% to 68.4%. Gains are smaller on local math-token edits. This pattern fits the system design: passage-wise review plus running summarization helps when the error depends on longer argumentative structure or cross-section consistency, but offers less advantage for highly local symbolic corruption.

A particularly useful finding is model complementarity. Different backend models, even under the same OpenAIReview scaffold, comment on different paragraphs and catch different subsets of errors. When combining outputs from all models, recall reaches 83.3%, which is 11.7 points above GPT-5.5 alone. That suggests reviewer-style error detection has broad coverage gaps and may benefit from committee-style aggregation rather than relying on a single stronger model.

The deployment study covers 1,360 reviews over 1,100 papers. User feedback is net positive, with likes outnumbering dislikes by 1.44 to 1, and many comments marked as addressed. The main failure mode is precision, not complete nonsense: users mostly complain about false positives and minor nitpicks. This is an important complement to the recall-heavy benchmark results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem framing and evaluation setup. The key is to understand that the target is not score prediction but actionable, grounded review comments produced by a full pipeline. Then focus on two sections.

First, read the quality-proxy evaluation carefully. Pay attention to how pairwise accuracy is defined, why comment count is used as a weak quality signal, and what biases enter through citations, acceptance decisions, and reviewer scores. This section is useful because it shows how to evaluate systems when direct labels are noisy or unavailable.

Second, spend most of the time on the perturbation benchmark. That is the most reusable methodological contribution. Look closely at how the four error types are injected, how ground truth is aligned, and how recall is computed. The main figure and the per-error-type tables are where the paper becomes most informative about what the system design is actually buying.

If time permits, inspect the OpenAIReview pipeline diagram: passage-level review, running summarization, and comment aggregation. Those modules map directly to common design choices in long-context agentic systems. End with the deployment analysis to see how offline recall translates imperfectly into user-perceived utility.

The most interesting follow-up questions are whether comment count is too entangled with verbosity, how to jointly optimize recall and precision, and whether the observed multi-model complementarity reflects true capability diversity or merely stochastic variation.
